test_objective: Check that one can update entity attributes

test_cases.name: 011_01_01 Check that one can update existing attributes with no datasetId
test_cases.doc: Check that one can update entity attributes
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Update Entity Attributes with Response Status Code set to 204     and
        Retrieve Entity by Id with Check Updated Entity and
            Query Parameter: 'updated_resource' set to 'entity_expectation_payload' and
            Query Parameter: 'response_body' set to 'response1.json()' and
            Query Parameter: 'ignored_keys' set to 'ignored_attributes'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'vehicle-speed-two-datasetid-01-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
